titleEn: Whole House vs Condo Renovation Cost in Vancouver (2026): Real Project Data
titleZh: 温哥华全屋装修与公寓装修费用对比（2026）：真实项目数据分析
excerptEn: A detailed cost comparison of whole-house and condo renovations in Vancouver, backed by real Reno Stars project data. Learn what determines your renovation budget before you sign a contract.
excerptZh: 基于 Reno Stars 真实项目数据，详细对比温哥华全屋装修与公寓装修的费用构成。签约前了解装修预算的决定因素。
contentEn:
Renovation costs in Vancouver vary dramatically depending on whether you own a single-family home or a strata condo — not just in square footage, but in permit requirements, material logistics, and the complexity of working in shared buildings. Reno Stars has completed 58 renovation projects across Metro Vancouver. Here is what the real numbers show.

How Much Does a Whole-House Renovation Cost in Vancouver?

A complete whole-house renovation in Vancouver typically ranges from $180,000 to $450,000 or more, depending on scope and finish level. This includes structural updates, rewiring, plumbing relocation, and finishing work across all floors. Reno Stars' project data shows that whole-house projects completed in 2024 and 2025 ranged from 12 weeks for a focused renovation (kitchen, bathrooms, and flooring refresh) to over 24 weeks for full gut renovations involving layout changes and structural work.

Key cost drivers for whole houses include structural permits ($3,000-$12,000), HVAC upgrades ($8,000-$25,000), and the need to coordinate work across multiple occupied floors while the family remains in the home.

How Much Does a Condo Renovation Cost in Vancouver?

Condo renovations in Vancouver typically cost between $35,000 and $180,000. Strata regulations and shared-wall logistics add complexity that does not appear in per-square-foot pricing. A full kitchen renovation in a Vancouver condo — including custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, and new electrical — generally falls between $25,000 and $65,000. Bathroom renovations range from $12,000 for a partial refresh to $35,000 for a full gut renovation.

Condo projects also carry strata approval costs ($200-$2,000) and require licensed contractors for any work affecting shared plumbing or electrical systems — requirements that single-family homes do not face.

Key Differences: Whole House vs Condo Renovation

FactorWhole HouseCondo
Typical total cost$180,000-$450,000+$35,000-$180,000
Permit complexityHigh (structural permits)Moderate (strata approval)
Typical timeline12-24+ weeks4-16 weeks
Material logisticsFull truck delivery, site storageFreight elevator booking, unit-only storage
HVAC scopeFull system replacement possibleLimited to unit-only components
Living during renoOften remain in homeUsually vacate during major work

What Drives the Final Cost in Either Case?

Regardless of property type, three factors determine where your project lands within those ranges. First, the scope of work — cosmetic refresh versus structural change. Moving plumbing fixtures or removing walls requires licensed trades and permits, pushing cost and timeline up significantly. Second, finish level. Custom millwork, imported tile, and premium fixtures add 30-50% to a mid-range budget. Third, the age of the building. Pre-1980s Vancouver homes and condos often require electrical panel upgrades or repiping that newer builds do not.

Real Project Examples from Reno Stars

Reno Stars' portfolio includes a whole-house renovation in Richmond that addressed a 40-year-old electrical system, a full kitchen and three-bathroom renovation in a Vancouver Westside condo, and a whole-home refresh in Surrey that included new flooring, trim, and a reconfigured master bathroom. Each project was scoped after an on-site assessment, with pricing confirmed before work began.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars. Our team assesses every project in person and provides a detailed scope before any work starts.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need a permit for a whole-house renovation in Vancouver?

Yes, for any structural changes, rewiring, or plumbing relocation. A building permit in Vancouver ranges from $3,000 to $12,000 depending on the scope. Cosmetic work — painting, flooring, and cabinet refacing — does not typically require a permit, but always confirm with the City of Vancouver building department before starting.

Do condos require strata approval for renovations?

Yes. Any work that affects shared walls, floors, plumbing in shared pipes, or the exterior of the unit requires strata council approval. This can add 2-6 weeks to your project timeline. Non-structural cosmetic work inside your unit — painting, flooring, and cabinet replacement — typically only requires notifying the strata, not full approval.

How long does a condo renovation take in Vancouver?

A partial bathroom refresh takes 2-4 weeks. A full kitchen renovation takes 4-8 weeks. A full gut renovation of a kitchen and two bathrooms in a Vancouver condo typically takes 8-16 weeks including strata approval time. Permit and strata delays are the most common reasons for timeline overruns.

Why do whole-house renovations cost more than condos?

Whole houses require full-system work — HVAC, electrical panels, and plumbing lines that run the full height of the building. There are no shared-wall constraints in a single-family home, which means structural changes are more feasible but more expensive. Additionally, whole-house projects typically involve coordinating work across multiple floors while the occupants remain in the home, which adds time and complexity.

Can I get an accurate quote before work starts?

Yes. Reno Stars provides a detailed, written scope and quote after an on-site assessment. We do not provide estimates without seeing the existing conditions. Our project managers walk through every room, document existing conditions, and discuss your goals before a single dollar figure is committed to paper.

contentZh:
温哥华的装修费用因物业类型而差异显著——不仅仅是面积差异，还涉及许可证要求、材料物流以及在共有建筑中施工的复杂性。Reno Stars 已在温哥华都会区完成58个装修项目。以下是真实数据呈现的情况。

温哥华全屋装修费用是多少？

温哥华全屋整体装修通常在18万至45万加元以上，具体取决于装修范围和装修标准。这包括结构改造、线路更新、管道移位以及各楼层的精装修。Reno Stars 项目数据显示，2024至2025年完成的全屋项目工期从专注型装修（厨房、浴室、地板翻新）的12周，到全拆装修的24周以上不等。

全屋装修的主要成本驱动因素包括：结构许可证（3,000-12,000加元）、暖通空调升级（8,000-25,000加元），以及在家庭继续居住的情况下协调多层施工的复杂性。

温哥华公寓装修费用是多少？

温哥华公寓装修通常在3.5万至18万加元之间。共管法规和共用墙体的物流增加了单尺定价中看不到的复杂性。温哥华公寓的全套厨房装修——包括定制橱柜、石英石台面和新电气——一般在2.5万至6.5万加元之间。浴室装修从局部翻新约1.2万加元到全拆装修约3.5万加元不等。

公寓项目还需支付共管委员会审批费用（200-2,000加元），并且任何影响共用管道或电气系统的工作都需要持牌承包商——这是独立屋不会面对的要求。

关键差异：全屋装修 vs 公寓装修

因素全屋装修公寓装修
典型总费用18万-45万加元以上3.5万-18万加元
许可证复杂性高（结构许可证）中等（共管审批）
典型工期12-24周以上4-16周
材料物流整卡车配送、现场仓储货运电梯预约、单元内仓储
暖通空调范围可全系统更换仅限于单元内组件
装修期间居住通常继续住在屋内重大工程期间通常搬离

无论哪种情况，最终成本由什么决定？

无论物业类型如何，三个因素决定您的项目落在哪个区间。第一，施工范围——表面翻新与结构改造。移动管道设施或拆除墙体需要持牌工匠和许可证，会大幅推高成本和工期。第二，装修标准。定制木制品、进口瓷砖和高端洁具会使中等预算增加30%至50%。第三，建筑物年份。1980年代以前的温哥华住宅和公寓通常需要进行电路板升级或管道更换，而较新的建筑则不需要。

Reno Stars 真实项目案例

Reno Stars 的项目组合包括：列治文一处涉及40年旧电线系统的全屋装修、温哥华西端一套公寓的厨房和三间浴室全装、以及素里一处包括新地板、木工和主卧浴室重新规划的全屋翻新。每个项目在开工前都经过现场评估，并提供详细报价。

计划进行厨房、浴室、全屋或商业装修？免费获取 Reno Stars 的无义务报价。我们的团队在开工前会对每个项目进行现场评估，并提供详细装修方案。

常见问题

温哥华全屋装修需要许可证吗？

是的，任何结构改造、线路更换或管道移位都需要许可证。温哥华的建筑许可证费用根据工程范围从3,000至12,000加元不等。表面工程——油漆、铺地板和橱柜翻新——通常不需要许可证，但在开工前务必向温哥华市建筑部门确认。

公寓装修需要共管委员会审批吗？

是的。任何影响共用墙、地板、共用管道或外墙的工程都需要共管委员会批准。这可能将项目工期延长2至6周。单元内的非结构性表面工程——油漆、铺地板和橱柜更换——通常只需通知共管委员会，无需全面审批。

温哥华公寓装修需要多长时间？

浴室局部翻新需2至4周。全套厨房装修需4至8周。温哥华公寓厨房和两间浴室全拆装修，包括共管审批时间，通常需8至16周。许可证和共管审批延误是工期超支的最常见原因。

为什么全屋装修比公寓装修贵？

全屋装修需要全系统工程——贯穿整栋建筑高度的暖通空调、电路板和管道线路。独立屋没有共用墙约束，这意味着结构改造更可行但也更昂贵。此外，全屋装修通常需要在家庭继续居住的情况下协调多层施工，这增加了时间和复杂性。

开工前能得到准确报价吗？

能。Reno Stars 在现场评估后提供详细的书面方案和报价。我们不会在未查看现有条件的情况下提供估算。我们的项目经理会走遍每个房间，记录现有条件，并在您承诺任何数字之前讨论您的需求。

计划进行厨房、浴室、全屋或商业装修？免费获取 Reno Stars 的无义务报价。

持ち家のフルリホーム費用

バンクーバーの持ち家完全リホームは通常18万-45万加元以上。構造更新、配線再設置、配管位移、全層にわたる仕上工事を含む。2024-2025年に完了した持ち家プロジェクトは12週間（キッチン・バス・フロアクリアlesh）から24週以上（構造変更・構造工事伴うフルgut）にわたりました。

分譲マンション費用

バンクーバーのマンション税関は通常3.5万-18万加元。管理組合規制と壁共有の複雑さが単符平方フィート単価に見えない形で加算されます。キッチン全套税関（カスタムキャビネット、クォーツカウンター、新電気）は通常2.5万-6.5万加元。バスルーム税関は1.2万-3.5万加元。

밴쿠버의 리노베이션 비용은 싱글 패밀리하우스인지 아파트인지에 따라 크게 다릅니다. Reno Stars는 Metro Vancouver에서 58개のリノベ 프로젝트를 완료했습니다. 실제 데이터는 다음과 같습니다.

주택 전체 리노베이션 비용

밴쿠버 주택 전체 리노베이션은 일반적으로 18만-45만 캐나다 달러 이상입니다. 구조 업데이트, 배선 재설치, 배관 이동, 모든 층의 미완공 작업을 포함합니다. 2024-2025년에 완료된 주택 프로젝트는 12주에서 24주 이상 걸렸습니다.

아파트 리노베이션 비용

밴쿠버 아파트 리노베이션은 일반적으로 $35,000-$180,000. 관리 조합 규정과 공유 벽 물류가 평방 피트당 가격에 반영되지 않는 복잡성을 추가합니다. 전체 키친 리노베이션(맞춤 캐비닛, 콰르츠 좌면, 새 전기 포함)은 일반적으로 $25,000-$65,000.

Los costos de renovación en Vancouver varían dramáticamente según si posee una casa unifamiliar o un condo — no solo en pies cuadrados, sino en requisitos de permisos, logística de materiales y complejidad de trabajar en edificios compartidos. Reno Stars ha completado 58 proyectos de renovación en Metro Vancouver.

¿Cuánto cuesta una renovación de casa completa en Vancouver?

Una renovación completa de casa en Vancouver oscila típicamente entre $180,000 y $450,000+ CAD. Incluye actualizaciones estructurales, nuevo cableado, reubicación de plomería y acabado en todos los pisos. Los proyectos de Reno Stars en 2024-2025 tomaron de 12 a más de 24 semanas.

¿Cuánto cuesta una renovación de condo en Vancouver?

Las renovaciones de condo en Vancouver oscilan entre $35,000 y $180,000 CAD. Una renovación completa de cocina en un condo de Vancouver oscila entre $25,000 y $65,000. Los baños van de $12,000 a $35,000.

Más detalles：Obtenga una cotización gratuita y sin compromiso de Reno Stars。

溫哥華全屋裝修費用是多少？

溫哥華全屋整體裝修通常在18萬至45萬加元以上，具體取決於裝修範圍和裝修標準。2024至2025年完成的全屋項目工期從12週到24週以上不等。

溫哥華公寓裝修費用是多少？

溫哥華公寓裝修通常在3.5萬至18萬加元之間。全套廚房裝修一般在2.5萬至6.5萬加元之間。浴室裝修從約1.2萬加元到約3.5萬加元不等。
